items.headline_en: Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs.
items.summary_en: agentes-chat/agentes-chat - Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0. Gained 1,757 GitHub stars in 11 days (~160/day).

items.headline_en: AnyModelBot Connects 70+ AI Models
items.summary_en: AnyModelBot is an open-source, local-first platform that lets users run personal bots across 70+ models, including GPT, Claude and Gemini, through one Modelflare key. Bots are reachable in the app, WeChat or Feishu, can remember users, work in the background, run commands and use the user's computer, giving users one-key access to multiple models with pay-per-use billing; Grok Bot is a similar alternative.
items.headline_zh: AnyModelBot 整合 70+ AI 模型
items.summary_zh: AnyModelBot（開源本機優先 AI 助理）以單一 key 接通 70+ 模型，可經 App、微信或飛書。用戶毋須逐款配置，可讓 bot 記憶、後台工作、執行指令及操作電腦，按用量付費；同類選擇有 Grok Bot。

items.headline_en: Sapper v2, an AI Pentest System, Wins 634-Team Challenge
items.summary_en: Sapper v2 is an autonomous, evolvable AI pentesting system from Nüwa Foundation’s Create, Language and History components, and it won a challenge among 634 teams after eight unattended hours. Users can grow and evolve their own agents for unattended testing instead of manually chaining every step, and the project gained 2,491 GitHub stars in 20 days.
items.headline_zh: Sapper v2奪634隊AI滲透挑戰冠軍
items.summary_zh: Sapper v2（Nüwa Foundation的AI滲透測試專案）可建立、演化並支援8小時無人值守運行的代理，在634隊挑戰中奪冠。用戶毋須再自行串接流程，可讓代理持續工作；同類選擇可比較PentestGPT。

items.headline_en: STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified
items.summary_en: Dodaios/ste80-humanizer - STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared. Gained 980 GitHub stars in 10 days (~95/day).

items.headline_en: trnrt Enables LLM Inference on AWS Trainium
items.summary_en: trnrt is an open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium with NKI megakernels, 1M-token context, and an OpenAI-compatible API. Developers can use a familiar API on Trainium instead of building a custom integration while handling long contexts; the repository gained 1,638 GitHub stars in 20 days.
items.headline_zh: trnrt 支援 Trainium 大模型推理
items.summary_zh: trnrt 是 AWS Trainium 的開源推理引擎，採用 NKI megakernels、百萬 token 上下文及 OpenAI 相容 API。用戶可沿用接口部署，減少整合並處理長上下文；同類選擇有 vLLM。

items.headline_en: Run models larger than your RAM or VRAM by streaming MoE experts from SSD.
items.summary_en: wici-ai/inferssd - Run models larger than your RAM or VRAM by streaming MoE experts from SSD. Built on llama.cpp. Gained 1,255 GitHub stars in 29 days (~44/day).

items.headline_en: Turbo Browser MCP Streamlines Playwright Automation
items.summary_en: Turbo Browser MCP is a Playwright MCP server offering one-call form filling, delta snapshots, batched steps, and a submit guard enabled by default; it gained 132 GitHub stars in five days. By reducing browser-agent turns and token use versus step-by-step control, it simplifies automation, while Microsoft Playwright MCP is another option.
items.headline_zh: Turbo Browser MCP 精簡自動化
items.summary_zh: Turbo Browser MCP 係 Playwright 自動化伺服器，支援一次填表、增量快照、批次操作及預設提交保護。過往逐項操作增加輪次與 token 消耗，現在可精簡流程；可選微軟 Playwright MCP。

items.headline_en: Inside LLM Compares Quantized GGUF Models
items.summary_en: Inside LLM is a browser-based tool that reveals where two GGUF quantizations diverge token by token and shows how different samplers affect outputs. Users can compare model behavior directly instead of manually checking results from separate runs.
items.headline_zh: Inside LLM 比較 GGUF 量化差異
items.summary_zh: Inside LLM 是一個瀏覽器模型比較工具，可逐 token 比較兩個 GGUF 量化模型的分歧，並查看不同採樣器如何影響輸出。用戶毋須逐個載入模型再肉眼對照，現在亦可用 LM Studio 或 llama.cpp。

Users can use an existing marketing toolkit instead of building every capability separately; the repository gained 698 GitHub stars in three days.

items.headline_en: Craft adds design workflows for AI agents
items.summary_en: Craft is a set of design skills for AI agents that writes a design brief, creates screens covering every state from a design system, and reviews the results. It works with Paper, pen.dev, Figma, or HTML, letting users automate briefs, interface states, and reviews that previously required manual design work; similar alternatives include AI UI generators.
items.headline_zh: Craft 為 AI 代理加入設計流程
items.summary_zh: Craft 是一套供 AI 代理使用的設計技能，可先撰寫設計簡報，再按設計系統製作涵蓋各種狀態的介面並加以審查。它支援 Paper、pen.dev、Figma 或 HTML；以往要手動整理要求及檢查狀態，現在可交由代理處理，四天內獲得了 271 個 GitHub 星標。同類選擇還有 AI UI 生成工具。

items.headline_en: Voicebox Enables Offline Voice Cloning on Android
items.summary_en: Voicebox is an Android app for offline voice cloning and trilingual text-to-speech, powered by GPT-SoVITS and supporting Chinese, Japanese and English. This lets users create cloned speech without relying on cloud speech services; the project gained 135 GitHub stars in five days.

items.headline_en: DeepSeek V4P1 Flash API input price halved
items.summary_en: Fireworks AI’s DeepSeek V4P1 Flash 1017 Ultrafast API—an endpoint developers use to access the model—is listed with a 50% input-price cut, from $2.40 to $1.20 per 1 million tokens, in LiteLLM’s community price registry. Developers using this endpoint can check their next bill for lower input costs and compare other model APIs as alternatives.
items.summary_zh: Fireworks的DeepSeek V4P1 Flash 1017 Ultrafast AI介面供程式呼叫；LiteLLM價格庫顯示，輸入價由每百萬詞元2.40美元降至1.20美元，減半。用戶可減成本，可選同類API。

items.headline_en: Fireworks DeepSeek API price cut
items.summary_en: The LiteLLM Price Registry records a 50% output-price cut for Fireworks AI’s DeepSeek V4P1 Flash Ultrafast API route, from $9.60 to $4.80 per 1M output tokens. The same output volume now costs less, and other DeepSeek API routes are worth comparing.
items.summary_zh: Fireworks AI DeepSeek API 路由降價，每百萬 token 由 9.60 美元降至 4.80 美元。以前成本較高，而家輸出量不變，用戶帳單可望減少；同類選擇可比較其他 DeepSeek 路由。

items.headline_en: Fireworks AI Cuts DeepSeek API Input Price by 33%
items.summary_en: The LiteLLM community price registry shows Fireworks AI’s spot-deepseek-v4-flash input price falling from $0.10 to $0.07 per 1 million tokens. Developers using that route can spend about one-third less on input tokens for the same workload at the listed rate.
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM 顯示，Fireworks AI（API 服務）的 DeepSeek 路由，每百萬輸入 token 價由 0.10 美元降至 0.07 美元。開發者可少付三成輸入費，亦可比較其他 DeepSeek 路由。

items.headline_en: Fireworks AI Cuts Spot DeepSeek V4 Flash API Output Price by 33%
items.summary_en: LiteLLM’s community price registry shows Fireworks AI’s Spot DeepSeek V4 Flash API output price fell 33%, from $0.21 to $0.14 per 1 million output tokens. Users can check the new rate before their next API bill to potentially reduce output costs.
items.summary_zh: LiteLLM價格庫顯示，模型API服務商Fireworks AI的Spot DeepSeek V4 Flash輸出價下調33%，每百萬token由0.21美元降至0.14美元。用戶查新價省支出；可比較OpenRouter。

items.headline_en: Fireworks AI GLM Input Price Falls 29%
items.summary_en: The LiteLLM Price Registry, a catalog of model API prices, shows Fireworks AI’s glm-5p3-spot input route falling from $0.98 to $0.70 per 1M tokens, a 29% cut. At the same usage, developers on this route will pay less for input on future API bills.
items.summary_zh: Fireworks AI 的 glm-5p3-spot 是 API 輸入路由；LiteLLM 價格表顯示，每百萬 token 由 $0.98 降至 $0.70，減幅 29%。沿用它，帳單成本可降低；同類可選 GLM 路由。

items.headline_en: GLM-5p3 Spot output price cut
items.summary_en: Fireworks’ glm-5p3-spot API route has cut output-token prices by 28.6%, according to LiteLLM’s Price Registry. At the listed rate, developers pay $2.20 instead of $3.08 per million output tokens and can compare other model APIs for alternatives.
items.summary_zh: Fireworks的glm-5p3-spot API路由在LiteLLM API價格庫顯示輸出token降價28.6%。開發者每百萬輸出 token由原本3.08美元降至2.20美元，節省API成本；亦可比較其他API。

items.headline_en: Fireworks' DeepSeek Input Price Drops 29%
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Spot is a Fireworks AI API route, and LiteLLM's Price Registry records a 29% input-price cut, from $0.21 to $0.15 per million tokens. Developers can now pay less for the same volume of input tokens through this route; a comparable alternative is DeepSeek's official API.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Spot 是 Fireworks AI 供開發者呼叫模型的 API 端點；LiteLLM Price Registry 顯示，其輸入價由每百萬詞元 0.21 美元降至 0.15 美元，減約 29%。過往相同輸入量須付較高價格，現時經此端點呼叫可降低輸入成本；同類選擇可比較 DeepSeek 官方 API。

items.summary_zh: Fireworks AI（模型API服務）的DeepSeek v4p1 Flash Spot輸出價下調29%，每百萬個輸出token由0.84降至0.60美元。API帳單成本可望降低；同類可選DeepSeek官方API

Developers can expect a lower API bill for the same input-token volume, and other similar routes are worth comparing.

items.headline_en: DeepSeek-V4 Flash Output Price Falls 29%

items.summary_en: Mistral's status page reports a minor service outage. Users may see temporary disruptions, so checking the status page can help distinguish a service issue from prompt problems.
items.headline_zh: Mistral 報告輕微服務中斷
items.summary_zh: Mistral（AI模型及API服務商）提供AI模型與API服務；狀態頁回報輕微服務中斷，相關服務可能短暫受阻。使用者以往可能先排查提示詞，現在可查看狀態頁，較快判斷是否服務故障；替代方案可看 OpenAI API。

items.headline_en: Copilot Service Restored
items.summary_en: Microsoft Copilot, an AI assistant, has returned to normal operations after an earlier service issue. Users can generally use it again, though the cause and affected features were not specified.
items.summary_zh: Microsoft Copilot係一款AI助手，早前服務異常後，狀態已回復全部系統正常。用戶現可重新使用服務，毋須再受先前中斷影響；不過原始原因及受影響功能未有交代。同類選擇有ChatGPT。
